4449.title: Desktop find-bar visibility: native reproduction blocked
4449.rootCauseOneLine: Product root cause is undetermined: native Electron startup is blocked by missing Linux GUI libraries; passing mocked tests and an HTML control do not verify compositing.
4449.proposedFix: No speculative fix. Reproduce on an isolated Linux Mint Cinnamon desktop at the trusted commit; capture the native window before and after opening a menu and inspect child-view bounds, visibility, focus and paint state.
4449.caveats: Native reproduction was blocked in both clean checkouts. NOT REPRODUCED does not refute the report. The screenshot is an isolated HTML control, not the native desktop. Verification confirms these limited results, not absence of the bug. No failing regression, so no pull request.
